copy.labBlurb: Tababar xaalado ku dhisan. Doorta, arka waxa xiga, dabadeedna ka wada hadla.
copy.labGate: Afar tababar oo kooban oo ku saabsan waxa guurka dhisa iyo waxa adkeeya. Mid kasta xaalado nolol-maalmeed ah ayuu leeyahay. Labadiinuba si gaar ah ayaad u doorataan, aragtaanna halka doorashadu idin geyso, dabadeedna ka wada hadashaan.
copy.quizzesBlurb: Ka fudud oo degdeg ah. Si gaar ah uga jawaaba, dabadeedna natiijada wada arka.
copy.quizzesGate: Xirmooyin kaarar oo degdeg ah oo madadaalo leh si aad isu barataan, ciyaaro saadaalin ah, su’aalo doorasho ah iyo isbarbardhig ku saabsan lacagta, qoyska iyo mustaqbalka.
copy.adventuresBlurb: Sheekooyin marba midkiin go’aan ku gaadho; doorasho kastana beddesho dhammaadka.
copy.adventuresGate: Sheekooyin ku saabsan lammaane is qaba, jidkoodana idinku dooranaysaan. Marba mid ayaa go’aan qaadanaya; mararka qaar si qarsoodi ah oo isku mar ah ayaad u dooranaysaan, mararka qaarna wadajir, eega halka ay ku dambayso.
copy.trackHint: Kaararka waxaa loo doortaa heerka xiriirkiinna. Midkiin kasta wuu beddeli karaa.
copy.journalBlurb: Heshiisyadiinna iyo casharradiinna oo hal meel yaal.
copy.journalEmpty: Weli waxba ma jiraan. Ciyaarta dhexdeeda kaydiya casharrada iyo heshiisyada aad labadiinuba rabtaan, ama kuwo cusub qorta.

copy.premiumTitle: Halal Cards wuxuu ka mid yahay Premium
copy.premiumBody: Haddii midkiin leeyahay Premium, waxaad Halal Cards uga furi kartaan xiriirkiinna oo {{name}} ku casuumi kartaa ciyaarta, uma baahna inuu isagu isdiiwaangeliyo.

copy.askMessage: Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan Halal Cards kula tijaabiyo, markaad fursad hesho ma bilaabi kartaa? 🙂

copy.how.quiz: Kaadh kasta si gaar ah uga jawaab. Jawaabna lama muujinayo ilaa labadiinuba ka jawaabtaan.

content.lab-rule-zero.title: Si fiican u dooro
content.lab-rule-zero.tagline: Ka fiiri soo jiidashada oo arag qofka aad nolosha la wadaagi lahayd.
content.lab-rule-zero.description: Guur badan oo dhibaato gala waxaa la go’aamiyay ka hor murankii ugu horreeyay, xilligii doorashada. Wada eeg afar xaaladood oo ogow waxa midkiin kasta muhiim u arko, iyo waxa uu indhaha ka qarsado.
content.lab-rule-zero.cover.alt: Laba koob oo shaah ah oo miis kafee saaran, iyadoo iftiinka galab dambe ku dhacayo.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-intro.title: Soo jiidashadu way bilowdaa. Dabeecaddu way sii waddaa.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-intro.body: Inaad qof u bogto waa muhiim, waxay qayb ka tahay is-waafajin wanaagsan. Laakiin soo jiidashadu way yaraataa oo soo noqotaa; dabeecadda, diinta, qiyamka iyo sida qofku walbahaarka ula tacaalo maalin kasta ayay muuqdaan. Casharkani wuxuu kaa caawinayaa inaad labadaba si cad u aragto.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.title: Qofka soo jiidashada leh
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.body: Imran waa kaftan badan yahay, isku kalsoon yahay, si fududna loola sheekaysan karaa. Saddex jeer oo ay kulmeen laba jeer ayuu soo daahay, kabalyeerigana si qallafsan ayuu ula hadlay; mar kasta oo salaaddu soo hadashana mawduuca ayuu beddelay.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.image.alt: Nin soo jiidasho leh oo qoslaya, halka kabalyeerigu aanu raaxo dareemayn.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.chem: Soo jiidashadan oo kale way dhif tahay, guurka ka dib wax walba way hagaagi doonaan.

Laba sano ka dib, daahitaanku caado ayuu noqday, qallafsanaantuna adiga ayay kugu wajahan tahay marka uu walwalo. Soo jiidashadu ma beddelin; waxay keliya kuu fududaysay inaad iska indho tirto calaamadihii hore.
Si toos ah uga weydii kabalyeeriga iyo salaadda, una fiirso sida uu uga jawaabo.

Wuu kaftan ku dhaafi karaa, is difaaci karaa, ama si daacad ah ayuu uga fiirsan karaa. Si kasta oo uu yeelo, waxaad ogaanaysaa sida uu uga jawaabo marka aad si deggan wax uga sheegto, waana sida uu guurka dhexdiisa uga jawaabi doono.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.fami: Qoyskaygu ha la kulmo oo ha arkaan waxa ay dareemaan.

Adeerkaa wuxuu dareemaa isla qallafsanaanta aad adigu aragtay. Dadka ku daneeya waxay arki karaan waxyaabaha soo jiidashadu kaa qarinayso, balse taladoodu waxay ugu faa’iido badan tahay marka ay la socoto su’aalahaaga, ee aanay beddelkooda noqon.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.walk: Hadda jooji, kuwani waa calaamado digniin ah.

Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad saxan tahay. Waxa kale oo dhici karta inaad toddobaad xun darteed wax u joojisay adigoon hal su’aal weydiin. Xuduudo cad waa wanaagsan yihiin; qofka oo aan la fahmin ka hor go’aanka waxay kaa lumin kartaa qof wanaagsan.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.title: Liiska
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.image.alt: Gabar da’yar oo dib u eegaysa liis ay gacanta ku qortay.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.body: Sana waxay leedahay liis: nin dheer, dhakhtar ama injineer ah, bulshadeeda ka soo jeeda, London-na deggan. Hamza shuruudahaas midna ma buuxiyo. Waa qof deggan oo naxariis leh, salaadda waqtigeeda tukada, si furanna uga hadla inuu guri xasilloon rabo.
Liiska ha ku adkaysato. Way garanaysaa waxa ay rabto.
Saddex sano oo kale ayay sugaysaa qof sanduuq kasta calaamadeeya, dabadeedna waxay ogaanaysaa in shuruuduhu wax yar ka sheegeen inay si naxariis leh u wada noolaan karaan iyo in kale.
Liiska ha u kala saarto waxyaabaha lama huraanka ah iyo kuwa fiican haddii la helo, dabadeedna ha dib u eegto.
Diinta, naxariista iyo rabitaanka guri isku mid ah ayaa ugu sarreeya. Dhererka iyo magaca shaqadu hoos bay u dhacaan. Hamza si lama filaan ah ayuu u noqdaa qof dhab ahaan la tixgelin karo.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.choices.settl: Liiska ha iska illowdo, Muslim kasta oo wanaagsan wuu ku filan yahay.

Inaad doorbid kasta iska tuurto waxay mustaqbalka keeni kartaa ciil. Qaar ka mid ah waxyaabaha liiska ku jira, sida meesha ay degayso, runtii way muhiim noqon karaan. Kala saaristu way ka fiican tahay in wax walba la iska tuuro.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.title: Su’aasha aan cidina weydiin
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.image.alt: Lamaane wada eegaya buug yar oo tirooyin ku qoran yihiin.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.body: Yusuf iyo Mariam si fiican bay isu fahmeen. Midkoodna ma weydiin deyn, kharashka, taageerada waalidka, ama cidda shaqaynaysa marka carruurtu yimaadaan. In laga hadlo waxay ula muuqataa wax jacaylka kharribaya.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.prompt: Goorma ayay tahay in arrimahan laga hadlo?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.choices.afte: Nikaxa ka dib. Hadda lacagta laga hadlo waxay kharribaysaa farxadda.

Saddex bilood ka dib, Mariam waxay ogaataa in Yusuf mushaharkiisa kala badh waalidkii u diro, baabuurna deyn ku leeyahay. Wax khalad ahi kuma jiro, balse inay hadda ogaato waxay dareensiinaysaa in wax laga qariyay.
Hadda uga hadla si naxariis leh oo cad, ka hor inta aan midkiin si weyn ugu xidhmin.

Toban daqiiqo ayay ka yara xishoodaan. Dabadeed waxay ogaadaan inay labaduba filayaan inay waalidka taageeraan, waxayna ku heshiiyaan sida loo samaynayo. Wadahadalkani wuxuu noqdaa kii kalsoonida dhisay.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.choices.fami: Qoysaska ha u daayaan inay arrinta xalliyaan.
Qoysasku waxay ku heshiiyaan meherka iyo kharashka arooska. Lacagta maalinlaha ah, caadooyinka, deymaha iyo mudnaanta, lagama hadlo, halkaas ayaana murannadu ka bilowdaan.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.title: Maalintii adkayd
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.image.alt: Nin da’yar oo daallan oo waardiye ku raalli gelinaya goobta tareenka.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.body: Safar tareen oo dheer, oo dib u dhacay, qof idin weheliyana idinla joogo, waxaad aragtaa qofka aad ka fikirayso marka samirkiisu dhammaanayo: daallan, gaajaysan, qorshayaashiisiina burbureen.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.per: Inuu si buuxda u degganaado. Wax kasta oo kale waa digniin.
Qofna mar walba si buuxda uma degganaado. Haddii aad taas filato, qof dhab ah ayaa ku niyad jabin doona, waxa muhiimka ahi waa sida qofku yahay marka aanu xaaladdiisa ugu fiicnayn.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.how: Sida uu dadka ula dhaqmo marka uu xanaaqsan yahay, iyo inuu dib isu dejin karo.
Wuu gunuunacaa, dabadeedna wuxuu raalli geliyaa waardiyihii uu ku xanaaqay, kaftanna wuu ka sameeyaa. Sida uu khaladkaas u saxo waa waxa aad guurka ugu baahan doontaan.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.ign: Waxba, qof walba maalin xun si gaar ah ayuu u noqdaa.
Maalmaha adag ayaa ah marka nolosha guurku dhab ahaan dhacdo. Haddii aad tiraahdo maalmahaas xisaab ma laha, waxaad seegaysaa xogta ugu daacadsan ee aad heli karto ka hor nikaxa.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.title: Waxa run ahaantii la fiiriyo
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.body: Soo jiidashadu waa sabab aad sheekada u sii waddo. Waxyaabahani ayaa go’aamiya in guurku adkaysto:
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.0: Diin aad wadaagi kartaan, ee aan ahayn magac keliya oo aad labadiinuba isticmaashaan
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.1: Dabeecadda marka cadaadis jiro, sida uu ula dhaqmo dadka aan waxba u qaban karin
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.2: Bisaylka dareenka: ma raalli gelin karaa, ma dhegaysan karaa, khaladkana ma sixi karaa?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.3: Qiyamka iyo filashooyinka: doorka lammaanaha, lacagta, carruurta, qoyska iyo meesha la degayo
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.4: In qoysaskiinnu noqon karaan hal qoys iyo in kale
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.prompt: Midkiin kasta ha sheego hal arrin aanu marnaba tanaasuli karin, iyo mid uu markii hore muhiim u arkayay balse hadda aanu u arag.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.followUps.0: Maxaad dareenteen in midkiin kasta xaaladahaas ku kala miisaamay?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.followUps.1: Su’aashee baad ugu baqaysaan inaad isweydiisaan?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.guide.z-g1.te: Su’aalaha aan jacaylka u ekaan goor hore ka wada hadla: lacagta, qoyska, carruurta iyo doorarka.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.guide.z-g2.te: Dabeecadda ka qiimee maalmaha adag, ee ha ka qiimayn kuwa fiican.
content.lab-rule-one.title: Dhibaatooyinka yaryar ha iska indho tirin
content.lab-rule-one.tagline: Waxyaabaha yaryar ee aan laga hadlin waxay isu beddelaan dhibaato weyn oo aan sahal lagu xallin karin.
content.lab-rule-one.description: Ciilku badanaa hal mar kuma bilowdo wax weyn. Wuxuu ka samaysmaa weel la iska daayay, hadal cashada lagu yiri, ama qorshe la beddelay iyadoo aan lagu weydiin. Baro inaad arrimaha yaryar ka hadasho intay weli yaryar yihiin.
content.lab-rule-one.cover.alt: Koob keliya oo ag yaalla saxanka jikada.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-intro.title: Waxyaabaha yaryar oo isbiirsada
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-intro.body: Wax kasta oo yar oo ku dhibaya ee aad iska liqdo waa culays yar. Mid keligiis wax badan ma aha. Laakiin marka ay isbiirsadaan, culays weyn bay noqdaan, maalin maalmaha ka mid ahna wax yar ayaa keena falcelin weyn, labadiinuna ma fahmaysaan sababta.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.title: Cashada iyo taleefanka
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.body: Lix bilood ayay is qabeen. Habeennada badankood, Adam taleefankiisa ayuu eegaa inta cashadu socoto. Layla way dhibsataa, balse waxay is leedahay wax yar bay ka dhigaysaa, shaqo badan buu qabtaa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.image.alt: Nin cashada taleefankiisa ku mashquulsan iyadoo xaaskiisu dhinac u jeeddo.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.swall: Ha iska dhaafto. Muranka uma qalmo.

Bilo ka dib, isagoo taleefanka eegaya ayuu dhegaysanayaa marka ay maalinteeda uga sheekaynayso, markaas ayay xanaaqdaa. Isagu wuu yaabaa, weligeed waxba ma sheegin. Iyadase waxay arrintani socotay nus sano.
Kaftan qaniinyo leh ha ka samayso inuu taleefankiisa guursaday.
Wuu qoslaa, waxbana iskama beddelo. Tilmaamtu waxay ku siinaysaa dareen ah inaad wax sheegtay, isaga se way u fududaynaysaa inuusan fahmin, kaftan qaniinyo lehna badanaa dhaliil ayuu u qaataa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.say.l: “Cashada waan kuu xiisaa. Ma iska dhigi karnaa taleefannada inta aan wax cunayno?”
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.say.c: Isagu ma dareensanayn. Wuu oggolaadaa, mararka qaarna wuu illoobaa, iyaduna si deggan ayay u xusuusisaa. Arrin yar baa sidii yarayd ku hadhay.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.title: Hadal ka dhacay guriga hooyadii
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.image.alt: Xaas da’yar oo dhoolla-caddaynaysa iyadoo casho qoys lagu jiro, balse aan raaxo qabin.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.body: Guriga hooyadii, waxay ku kaftamaysaa in cuntada Layla “weli tababar u baahan tahay”. Qof walba wuu qoslaa. Layla way dhoolla-caddaysaa. Adam wax khaldan ma dareemo.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.prompt: Markay guriga ku noqdaan, maxay Layla samaysaa?
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.fine: Waxba yaanay odhan. Kaftan buu ahaa, waana hooyadii.

Booqasho kasta kaftanku wuu soo noqnoqdaa. Layla waxay bilaabaysaa inay Jimcaha ka baqdo, dabadeedna marmarsiiyo u samaysato inaanay tegin. Adam wuxuu moodaa inaanay qoyskiisa jeclayn, taasna wuu ka xumaadaa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.atta: “Hooyadaa way i bahdishay, adiguna iska aamusay.”
Adam isla markiiba hooyadii ayuu difaacaa. Hadda waxay ka murmayaan cidda daacadda loo yahay, ee ma aha hal hadal, dhaawicii dhabta ahaana lama maqlayo.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.soft: “Hadalka cuntada wax yar buu i dhibay. Ma kuu sheegi karaa sababta?”
Adam waxba uma qaadan. Markay si deggan ugu sheegto, wuu fahmaa. Marka xigta wuxuu yiraahdaa, “Bariiska Layla waa kii ugu fiicnaa ee aan cunay,” hooyadiina way fahantaa tilmaanta.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.title: Hadda adiga ayaa la kuu sheegayaa
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.image.alt: Nin u soo jeestay si uu u dhegaysto xaaskiisa oo hadlaysa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.body: Lammaanahaagu si deggan ayuu kuu leeyahay: “Waxa i dhibaya inaad qorshaha dhammaadka toddobaadka noo go’aamiso adigoon i weydiin.” Ma aadan ogeyn. Waxay kula tahay dhaliil aan meelna ka soo bixin.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.de: “Waxaan sidaas u sameeyaa oo keliya sababtoo ah adigu waxba ma soo jeedisid.”
Run ha ahaato ama yaanay noqon, wuxuu baranayaa in arrin yar oo la sheego ay keento weerar celis. Marka xigta wuu iska aamusi doonaa, arrimihii yaryaraana way sii ururayaan.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.th: “Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad ii sheegtay. Maxaad jeclaan lahayd inaan beddelo?”

Wuu degaa. Waxaad ku heshiisaan inaad Sabtida qorshihiisa wada samaysataan. Maadaama ay fududayd inuu kuu sheego, wuxuu sii sheegi doonaa waxyaabaha yaryar, sidaas ayaad uga hortagaysaan inay wax waaweyn noqdaan.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.su: Waxay u ekaanaysaa oggolaansho, balse ciqaab ayay u dhacaysaa. Isbeddelkii wuu helay, diirimaadkiina wuu lumay. Marka xigta way ku adkaan doontaa inuu arrin yar soo qaado.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.title: Sababta waxyaabaha yaryar muhiim u yihiin
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.body: Inaad arrin yar soo qaaddo waa qayb keliya. Qaybta kale waa inaad ka dhigto mid ammaan ah in la maqlo. Lammaanaha si fiican isku fahma waxay hadalka arrimaha ka dhigaan wax sahlan, jawaabtana mid deggan.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.0: Maalin ama laba gudahood ka sheeg, intay weli yar tahay
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.1: Sheeg wixii dhacay iyo sidaad dareentay, ha ku xukumin qofnimadiisa
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.2: Codso wax cad oo gaar ah
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.3: Marka wax laguu sheego, marka hore u mahadnaq; sharraxaadda dabadeed bixi
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.prompt: Waa maxay arrin yar oo midkiin kasta dhibi lahayd haddii ay soo noqnoqoto? Hadda ka hadla, iyadoo ay weli mala-awaal tahay.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.followUps.0: Sidee baad jeclaan lahaydeen in lammaanihiinnu idiin sheego marka wax idin dhibayaan?
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.guide.o-g1.tex: Dhibaatooyinka yaryar goor hore ka hadal, intay weli yaryar yihiin.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.guide.o-g2.tex: Marka midkeen arrin soo qaado, kan kale marka hore ha yiraahdo mahadsanid.
content.lab-rule-two.title: Dhegayso ka hor intaadan is difaacin
content.lab-rule-two.description: Marka qof aad jeceshahay kaa xumaado, wax kasta oo kugu jira waxay rabaan inaad is sharraxdo. Isku day waxa ka adag: marka hore weydii, qir dareenkiisa oo muuji inaad fahantay, ka dibna is difaac.
content.lab-rule-two.cover.alt: Qof hadlaya, kan kalena si dhow ugu soo janjeedha si uu u dhegaysto.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-intro.title: Laba sheeko oo isku mar socda
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-intro.body: Marka qof dhaawac dareemo, kan kalena bilaabo is-sharraxaad, laba sheeko ayaa isku mar socda, midna si fiican looma maqlayo. Marka hore dhegaysigu ma aha inaad guuldarraysatay. Waa sida hadalku hal sheeko ku noqonayo.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.title: Mar kale wuu soo daahay
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.body: Zainab: “Waxaad tiri iftaarka guriga ayaad joogi doontaa. Mar kale kaligay ayaan afuray.” Omar wuxuu ku xannibnaa kulan aanu ka bixi karin.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.image.alt: Haweeney kaligeed fadhida miiska afurka, iyadoo ninkeedu soo daahay oo yimid.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.explai: “Kulanku wuu dheeraaday, wax aan samayn karay ma jirin.”
Waa run buuxda, haddana waxay dareemaysaa inaan la maqlin. Ma weydiinayn inuu isagu khaladka lahaa; waxay u sheegaysay inay kelinimo dareentay. Hadda waa inay ku dooddaa si loo fahmo.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.ack.la: “Kaligaa ayaad afurtay. Waa inay kelinimo ku noqotay.”
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.ack.co: Garbaheedu way dabcaaan. Daqiiqad ka dib ayay weydiisaa waxa dhacay, isaguna kulanka ayuu uga warramaa. Isla sharraxaaddii si kale ayay u dhacdaa ka dib markay dareento in la maqlay.
“Waan ka xumahay, waan ka xumahay. Mar dambe ma dhici doonto.”
Hadalka si dhakhso ah ayuu u dhammeeyaa, waxayna u ekaan kartaa in la iska fogaynayo. Raalli-gelin aan faham lahayn badanaa waxay u dhawaaqdaa “iska aamus si ay u joogsato”.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.title: Markay kula muuqato caddaalad darro
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.image.alt: Xaaska oo hakad gelinaysa si ay u dhegaysato ninkeeda oo niyad-jabsan.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.body: Ibrahim: “Mar walba walaashaa ayaad raacdaa.” Aisha waxay u aragtaa inaanay run ahayn, toddobaadkii hore isaga ayay raacday.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.corr: Ha xusuusiso toddobaadkii hore. “Mar walba” waa hadal aan caddaalad ahayn.
Waxay ku guulaysataa doodda eraygaas, sheekadiina way ku lumisaa. Isagu isagoo rumaysan inaanay xitaa dhegaysan karin ayuu ka tegayaa.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.curi: Waxay ahayd hal mar oo cashada dhexdeeda ah oo ay ku qososhay kaftankii walaasheed ee isaga ku saabsanaa. Taas in laga hadlo way ka sahlan tahay “mar walba”.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.agre: “Waad saxan tahay, mar walba sidaas ayaan sameeyaa. Waan ka xumahay.”
Inaad ku raacdo wax aadan rumaysnayn waxay dhistaa ciil qarsoon, isaguna ma ogaanayo waxa dhab ahaantii ku dhaawacay. Inaad dareenkiisa fahanto macnaheedu ma aha inaad isa soo dhiibtay.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.title: Dareenkiisa faham adigoon ku raacin
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.image.alt: Mid ka mid ah lammaanaha oo jilba joogsaday si uu kan kale u dejiyo.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.body: Lammaanahaagu wuu ka xumaaday inaad waalidkaa uga warrantay khilaaf idinka dhexeeyay. Adiga waxaad aaminsan tahay inay caadi ahayd inaad waalidkaa talo weydiisato.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.prompt: Jawaabtee muujinaysa inaad dareenkiisa fahantay adigoon aragtidaada ka tanaasulin?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.ye: “Waan fahmay sababta ay taasi kuugu ekayd khiyaamo, arrintu labadeenaba ayay noo dhexaysay. Ma kuu sheegi karaa sababta aan u sameeyay?”

Wuxuu dareemayaa in la fahmay, dabadeedna si dhab ah ayuu u dhegaystaa sababahaaga. Weli waad kala aragti duwanaan kartaan, balse hadda wadajir ayaad u go’aaminaysaan waxa qarsoodi ahaan idiin dhex jooga.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.bu: “Waan fahmay, laakiin waa waalidkay, talona waan u baahnaa.”
Erayga “laakiin” wuxuu tirtirayaa wax kasta oo ka horreeyay. Isagu difaaca oo keliya ayuu maqlayaa.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.ov: “Waad ka badbadinaysaa, arrin weyn ma aha.”
Qofka oo aad u sheegto inta uu dareenkiisu le’egaan karo ayaa ah sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ee dareenkaas loo sii weyneeyo.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.title: Dhegayso, weydii, qir, dabadeed sharax
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.body: Inaad tiraahdo “dareenkaagu waa la fahmi karaa” la mid ma aha inaad tiraahdo “waad saxan tahay”. Waad odhan kartaa adigoo weli diiddan.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.0: Ilaa uu hadalka dhammeeyo dhegayso, adigoon jawaabta sii diyaarsanayn
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.1: Hal su’aal weydii si aad wax badan u fahanto
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.2: Erayadaada ugu celi wixii aad ka fahantay
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.3: Qir dareenka: “Waan fahmi karaa sababta aad sidaas u dareentay”
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.4: Markaas oo keliya dhinacaaga sharax, si kooban
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.prompt: Marka aad xanaaqsan tahay, maxaad ugu baahan tahay inaad marka hore maqasho? Maxayse tahay jawaabta keliya ee xaaladda ka sii darta?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.followUps.0: Jawaabahee soo jiidashada leh ee kore ayaa kuugu ekaa?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.guide.t-g1.tex: Dhegayso oo muuji inaad fahantay ka hor intaadan is sharraxin ama is difaacin.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.guide.t-g2.tex: Inaad dareenka fahanto macnaheedu ma aha inaad ku raacday, labadaba waad sheegi kartaa.
content.lab-rule-three.title: Wareegga isu soo dhowaanshaha–ka fogaanshaha
content.lab-rule-three.tagline: Mid baa soo dhowaada, midna dib ayuu u gurtaa, labaduba waxay dareemaan kelinimo dheeraad ah.
content.lab-rule-three.description: Marka qofku dareemo kala fogaansho, waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ku soo dhowaado; marka kan kale cadaadis dareemo, waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dib u gurto. Ficil kasta kan kale ayuu sii kiciyaa. Baro inaad wareeggan aragtaan oo aad si wadajir ah uga baxdaan.
content.lab-rule-three.cover.alt: Laba qof oo ku socda waddo wareegsan; mid baa gacanta fidinaya, midna dhinac u jeesanaya.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-intro.title: Midkiinna dhib ma aha. Wareegga ayaa dhibka ah.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-intro.body: Qaar marka ay kala fogaansho dareemaan way soo dhowaadaan: farriimo badan, su’aalo badan. Qaar kalena marka cadaadis dareemaan way ka fogaadaan: way aamusaan, mashquul bay noqdaan, meel bay rabaan. Midkoodna khalad ma aha. Laakiin wadajir waxay geli karaan wareeg adag.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.title: Wuu aamusay
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.body: Bilal toddobaad adag ayuu soo maray, laba maalmoodna wuu aamusnaa, jawaabo gaagaaban, habeen horena wuu seexdaa. Safiya waxay is weydiinaysaa inay wax khalad ah samaysay.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.prompt: Haddii aad Safiya ahaan lahayd, maxaad samayn lahayd?
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.image.alt: Haweeney taleefankeeda eegaysa, ninkeeduna qol kale keligiis fadhiyo.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.cha: Weydii waxa qaldan ilaa uu ii sheego.

Su’aal kasta Bilal wuxuu u dareemaa cadaadis ah inuu iska dhigo inuu fiican yahay. Wuu sii aamusaa. Aamusnaantiisu Safiya way sii cabsi gelisaa, markaas ayay su’aalo badan weydiisaa. Wareeggiina wuu bilaabmaa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.mir: Aniguna waan aamusi, haddii uu meel u baahan yahay, ha helo.
Hadda labadooduba way kala durkeen, mid walbana aamusnaanta kan kale wuxuu u arkaa diidmo. Maalmo ayaa dhaafa, cidina ma garanayso sida dib loogu bilaabo.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.nam: “Waxaad u muuqataa qof daallan. Markaad rabto inaad hadasho waan kuu joogaa, degdeg ma jirto.”
Ma jiro wax uu iska difaacayo. Fiidkaas Bilal agteeda ayuu fadhiistaa, si tartiib ahna shaqada ayuu uga sheekeeyaa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.title: Hadda adigu Bilal baad tahay
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.image.alt: Nin daallan oo qol waxbarasho oo iftiinkiisu yar yahay jooga, hooska xaaskiisuna albaabka ka muuqdo.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.body: Wax walba way kugu bateen, waxaadna u baahan tahay aamusnaan. Safiya maanta saddex jeer ayay ku weydiisay inaad fiican tahay. Waxaad dareemaysaa inay kugu soo ururtay.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.shu: “Waan fiicanahay” dheh oo qol kale gal.
“Waan fiicanahay” oo albaab xiran waxay u sheegaysaa inay wax jiraan, iyadana dibadda looga reebay. Welwelkeedu wuu kacaa. Wareegguna wuu sii adkaadaa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.sna: “Fadlan mar dambe sidaas ha ii weydiin!”
Waxay u qaadanaysaa in daryeelkeedu culays kugu yahay. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay joojiso weydiinta, oo ay aamusnaan ku kaydsato wax kasta oo ku dhibay.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.ret: “Shaqadu way i daalisay. Caawa waxaan u baahanahay inaan nasto, berri salaadda Subax ka dib si fiican ma uga wada hadli karnaa?”
Inaad meel u baahato adigoo sheegaya goorta aad soo noqonayso aad bay uga duwan tahay inaad iska maqnaato. Way og tahay waxa dhacaya iyo goorta aad soo laabanayso. Iyaduna way nasan kartaa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.title: Ogow marka muranku dhexda ku jiro
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.image.alt: Xaaska oo ninkeeda ka daba socota marinka guriga, isaguna dhinac u jeesanayo.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.body: Labadiinuba waad ku jirtaan: mid baa kan kale qolba qol ula socda isagoo raba in hadda la xalliyo; kan kalena wuxuu leeyahay, “Hadda ma awoodo.”
Qofkii saxan ha sii wado hadalka ilaa arrinta la dhammeeyo.
Qof dib u guraya inaad riixdo badanaa waxba ma xalliso. Waxay inta badan ku dhammaataa hadal ka sii daran ama albaab la isku dhufto.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.choices.paus: Midkiin ha yiraahdo: “Waxaan u malaynayaa inaan wareeggan ku jirno. Aan nus saac hakanno dabadeedna soo noqonno.”
Markaad hab-dhaqanka magacawdaan, wuxuu noqdaa dhib aad wada leedihiin, ee idinka dhexdiinna ma aha. Nus saac ka dib labadiinuba waad deggan tihiin, si dhab ahna waad isu dhegaysanaysaan.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.choices.leav: Midkiin guriga ha ka baxo si uu u qaboojiyo isaga oo aan sheegin inta uu maqnaan doono.
Inaad is dejiso way caawisaa; inaad iska baaba’do ma caawiso. Qofka hadhay, maqnaanshaha aan la garanayn goorta uu dhammaanayo ayaa ugu adag.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.title: Sida wareegga looga baxo
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.body: Qofka soo dhowaada wuxuu is weydiinayaa, “Ma fiicanahaynaa?” Kan dib u gurtaa wuxuu is weydiinayaa, “Neef ma qaadan karaa?” Mid kastaaba kan kale wuu uga jawaabi karaa:
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.0: Qofka soo dhowaanaya: hal mar si diirran ula xiriir, dabadeedna ixtiraam inta uu u baahan yahay
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.1: Qofka dib u guraya: nasasho qaado, balse sheeg sababta iyo goorta aad soo noqonayso
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.2: Midkiin kasta ha magacaabo: “Waxaan u malaynayaa inaan wareegga ku jirno”
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.3: Soo noqo markaad tiri waad soo noqonaysaa, mar kasta
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.prompt: Marka jawigu kacsan yahay, ma waxaad u janjeertaa inaad soo dhowaato mise inaad dib u gurato? Maxaa lammaanahaagu kuu qaban karaa xilligaas?
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.followUps.0: Ku heshiiya eray ama weedh midkiin kasta ku odhan karo “wareegga ayaynu ku jirnaa”.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.guide.h-g1.t: Ha iska maqnaan marka khilaaf jiro.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.guide.h-g2.t: Isu sheega markaad nasasho u baahan tihiin iyo goorta aad soo noqonaysaan.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.guide.h-g3.t: Midkeen kasta wuxuu odhan karaa “wareegga ayaynu ku jirnaa”, markaasna nus saac ayaynu hakannaa.

content.adv-first-ramadan.title: Ramadaankii koowaad
content.adv-first-ramadan.tagline: Afar Jimce, hal afur qoys, iyo hadal sambuus ku saabsan.
content.adv-first-ramadan.description: Hamza iyo Noor waxay is qabeen afar bilood markii Ramadaan yimid, hooyada Hamzana qorshe bay u lahayd. Midba midka kale doorkiisa gala oo markaba go’aan gaadha. content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.invite.title: Wicitaankii telefoonka
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.invite.image.al: Hamza oo marinka telefoon kula hadlaya, Noor oo alaabtii la soo iibsaday furfuraysa.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.invite.passages: Laba maalmood ka hor Ramadaan, hooyada Hamza ayaa soo wacday. “Ramadaankiinnii ugu horreeyay idinkoo is qaba! Qoyska oo dhan gurigiinna ayuu afur ugu imanayaa, Jimce kasta. Gurigiinna cusub, cuntada Noor. Waxay noqon doontaa wax qurux badan.”
Noor jikada ayay joogtaa. Shaqo waqti-buuxa ah ayay haysaa, toddobaadkii horena waxay sheegtay inay Ramadaankan degganaan rabto: Qur’aan badan, taraawiix badan, kulanno qoys oo yaraada.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.invite.decision: Waxaad tahay Hamza. Hooyadaa maxaad ku odhanaysaa?
“Dabcan, hooyo! Aad baan u jeclaan lahayn.”
Hamza wuxuu oggolaaday afur afar Jimce ah isaga oo aan Noor weydiin.
Markaad laba qof magacooda ku oggolaato, waa go’aan ku saabsan waqtiga lammaanahaaga, adigoon isaga weydiin.
“Waa naxariis, hooyo. Noor aan kala tashado, caawana waan ku soo wacayaa.”
Hamza wuxuu hooyadii u sheegay inuu marka hore Noor kala tashanayo.
“Ka warran hal Jimce inaan ku bilowno? Noor bisha oo dhan way shaqaynaysaa.”
Hamza hooyadii wuxuu u soo bandhigay hal Jimce halkii afar, ka hor inta uusan Noor weydiin.
Noor oo habeenkii akhrinaysa farriimaha kooxda qoyska.
Fiidkaas kooxda WhatsApp-ka qoyska ayaa farriimo soo diraysa. “Jimcayaasha guriga Hamza iyo Noor waan sugaynaa!” Wadnayaal. Dumaashideed ayaa weydiisay waxa Noor karin doonto.
Noor farriimihii hore ayay dib ugu noqotaa. Hamza weli waxba ugama sheegin.
Tani waxay caawa ku dhammaan kartaa wada hadal shan daqiiqo ah, ama waxay noqon kartaa sheeko Noor bil dhan maskaxdeeda ku hayso.
“Kooxda ayaan ka ogaaday. Ma ka wada hadli karnaa sida arrintan loo go’aamiyay?”
Noor isla fiidkaas si deggan ayay arrinta Hamza ugala hadashay.
Marka dhaawac yar goor hore oo deggan laga hadlo, wuu yaryahay isaga oo sii ahaanaya.
Waxba ha odhan. Waa qoyskiisa; way iska maarayn doontaa.
Noor waxba ma odhan, waxayna go’aansatay inay iska adkaysato.
U fiirso sida arrin yar ciil ugu sii beddelmayso. Inaad aamusnaan ku adkaysato la mid ma aha inaad raalli ka tahay.
Kooxda ugu jawaab: “Waa wax fiican in qof ii sheego 🙂”
Noor farriin sarbeeb leh ayay kooxda qoyska ugu jawaabtay.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.group_fallout.i: Hamza oo telefoon kula hadlaya hooyadii oo ka xumaatay.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.group_fallout.p: Kooxdu way aamustaa. Dabadeed hooyada Hamza ayaa soo wacda iyadoo murugaysan. “Xaaskaagu miyaanay rabin inaan imaanno? Waxaan isku dayayay oo keliya inaan soo dhoweyn dareensiiyo.”
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.group_fallout.d: Waxaad tahay Hamza. Maxaad ku odhanaysaa?
“Noor ayay ahayd inaan weydiiyo. Khaladkayga ayay ahayd, hooyo, iyada ma aha.”
Hamza hooyadii ayuu masuuliyadda ka qaatay halkii uu Noor eedayn lahaa.
Inaad qaybtaada qirato waxay ilaalisaa lammaanahaaga, xiisaddana way dejisaa.
Hooyadii raalli geli, dabadeed Noor ku dheh way ku ceebaysay.
Hamza hooyadii ayuu raalli geliyay, Noor-na wuxuu ku yiri way ceebaysay.
Dhaawicii Noor ee laga reebay hadda dhaawac kale ayaa beddelay: in iyada lagu eedeeyo.
“Waxba ma aha, hooyo. Way iska hagaagi doontaa.”
Hamza hooyadii ayuu dejiyay, cid kalena lama hadlin.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.talk_plan.title: Miiska jikada
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.talk_plan.image: Hamza iyo Noor oo shaah ku dul qorshaynaya Ramadaan.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.talk_plan.passa: Hamza iyo Noor waxay la fariistaan laba koob oo shaah ah iyo kalandar.
Hamza hooyadii hal Jimce ayuu hore ugu ballanqaaday. Noor waxay ogaanaysaa inaan la weydiin, balse ugu yaraan hal Jimce oo keliya ayay ahayd.
Farriintii kooxda weli way dhex taallaa, haddana halkan ayay joogaan oo way wada hadlayaan.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.talk_plan.lesso: Labadiinuba waa inaad isla jawaabta doorataan. Haddii aad kala doorataan, ka wada hadla dabadeedna mar kale doorta.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.talk_plan.decis: Wadajir u go’aamiya: imisa afur oo qoys ayaad Ramadaankan martigelinaysaan?

content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.first_friday.pa: Afar iyo toban qof ayaa jooga guri afar qof loogu talagalay. Noor shaqada ayay ka soo hormartay, saddexdii galabnimo ayaanay cunto karinaysay.

Marka sambuuska la qaybinayo, hooyada Hamza way qososhay: “Qoyskeenna cusub ayaynu ka samaynaa, qaboojiyaha kama soo saarno. Iska daa, Noor way baran doontaa!” Dad yar ayaa la qosla.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.first_friday.le: Midkiin kasta goonidiisa ayuu u go’aaminayaa waxa dabeecaddiisu samayso, isku mar, isaga oo aan ogeyn doorashada kan kale.

content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.hamza_listens.p: Noor waxay sharraxaysaa: qof walba hortiisa, saacado cunto karis ah ka dib, waxay dareentay in la qiimaynayo.

“Waxay u muuqataa inay si dhab ah kuu dhaawacday. Maxaa ku caawin lahaa?”

Inaad dareenkeeda fahanto qasab ma aha inaad ku raacday. Hamza hooyadii wuu jeclaan karaa, haddana wuxuu qiri karaa in dareenka Noor la fahmi karo.

content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.blowup.title: Wax walba hal mar

content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.blowup.passages: Wax walba way soo butaacaan, kooxda sheekaysiga, Jimcayaasha, qosolkii, daalkii. Hamza albaabka jikada ayuu yaabban taagan yahay. Waxaas midna ma ogeyn.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.blowup.decision: “Waxaas oo dhan waad oggolaatay! Maxaad waxba u odhan weyday?”
Hamza wuxuu isku difaacay hadallada oo dhan mar qura ugu soo daatay.

content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.eid_morning.ima: Hamza iyo Noor oo albaabkooda jooga iyagoo Ciidda u lebisan.
content.adv-first-ramadan.scenes.eid_morning.pas: Subaxda Ciidda. Labada taleefan isku mar ayay yeedhaan. Hooyada Hamza: “Qadada gurigeenna, dabcan!” Hooyada Noor: “Duhurkii ayaan labadiinaba idin arki doonnaa, Insha Allaah.”

Guuritaanku mid buu ku habboonaaday, kan kalena si tartiib ah ayuu u wiiqay.
content.adv-long-way.endings.lonely_stay.couldHa: In kelinimadeeda loo qaato si la mid ah sida shaqadiisa loo tixgeliyo.
content.adv-long-way.endings.lonely_stay.takeawa: Guuritaanku waa go’aan fiican keliya haddii labadiinaba idiin fiican yahay.
content.adv-long-way.endings.lonely_stay.guide.l: Meesha aynu degayno waa inay labadeenna ku habboonaataa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.title: Laba nolol oo kala duwan
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.image.alt: Yusuf oo baxaya, Hafsana qoyska muuqaal-wicitaan kula hadlaysa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.whatHappe: Nolosha Yusuf waa shaqada iyo xeebta. Nolosha Hafsa waa wicitaannada guriga. Hal guri ayay wadaagaan.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.pattern.e: Mid walba keligiis ayuu xaaladda ula tacaalay, taasina way kala fogaysay.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.couldHave: Inay wax wada bilaabaan, kulanka, caado, wax kasta oo ay wadaagaan.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.takeaway: Meel cusub, ugu yaraan hal shay wada dhisa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.two_lives.guide.lw-: Meel cusub, ugu yaraan hal shay ayaynu wada dhisnaa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.deeper_faith.title: Iimaan deggan oo qoto dheer
Yusuf iyo Hafsa oo salaadda Subax ku tukanaya badda agteeda.
content.adv-long-way.endings.deeper_faith.whatHa: Masaajid iyo bulsho midna ma jiro, haddana iimaankooda, oo ay guriga ku wada dhaqmaan, weligii intan uma xoog badnayn.
content.adv-long-way.endings.deeper_faith.patter: Markii aanay haysan nidaam dibadeed, cibaadada waxay ka dhigeen caado ay wadaagaan.
content.adv-long-way.endings.deeper_faith.couldH: Bulsho yar weli way caawin lahayd.
content.adv-long-way.endings.deeper_faith.takeaw: Gurigu isaguna masaajid buu noqon karaa.
Cibaadada guriga wadajir ayaan ugu sii wadnaa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.title: Dib u guuritaan, dhaawac aan bogsan
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.image.alt: Yusuf iyo Hafsa oo aamusnaan ugu wada socdaal ku noqonaya magaalada.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.whatHappened: Dib bay u guureen. Yusuf xeebta ayuu u xiisay; Hafsa sannadkii dhacay weligeed si buuxda ugama saamixin.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.pattern.name: Dareen aan laga wada hadlin
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.pattern.expl: Kelinimada way ka baxsadeen, balse kama wada hadlin.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.couldHaveCha: Inay ka wada hadlaan waxa sannadku mid walba ku reebay.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.takeaway: Meel adag ka tagiddu ma bogsiiso wixii halkaas ka dhacay. Wada-hadalku wuu bogsiin karaa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.regret.guide.lw-e-t: Xilli adag ka dib, waxaynu ka wada hadalnaa waxa uu mid walba innaga reebay.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.title: Si tartiib ah ayay u soo hagaagaysaa
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.image: Yusuf iyo Hafsa oo xeebta deris kala sheekaysanaya.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.whatH: Weli si buuxda guri uma aha, balse magaalo shisheeye oo keliya ma aha.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.patte: Dareenka lahaanshuhu si tartiib ah ayuu u koraa, wayna ku sii dadaaleen.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.takea: Meel la jaanqaadkeeda toddobaad kasta wax yar baa dhisa.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.epilo: Xalaqada internetka ayaa Hafsa u noqotay garab ay ku tiirsanaato.
content.adv-long-way.endings.getting_there.guide: Toddobaad kasta hal shay ayaynu samaynaa si aynu meesha aynu deggen nahay qayb uga noqono.
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.title: Dib ugu noqosho wadajir ah
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.image: Yusuf iyo Hafsa oo guri cusub oo magaalada ah ku dhejinaya sawir badda ah.
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.whatH: Wadajir ayay u go’aansadeen inay dib u noqdaan. Sawirkii badda waxay ku dhejiyeen darbiga gurigooda cusub ee magaalada.
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.patte: Baahida labadoodaba ayay miisaameen, dabadeedna wadajir ayay u doorteen.
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.takea: Inaad wadajir fikradda u beddeshaan guuldarro ma aha.
content.adv-long-way.endings.honest_return.guide: Fikradayada waan beddeli karnaa, inta aan wada go’aansanayno.
content.adv-raised-voice.title: Codka Kor U Kaca
content.adv-raised-voice.tagline: Gurigiisa, qayladu waxba ma ahayn. Gurigeeda se wax weyn bay ka dhiganayd.
content.adv-raised-voice.description: Adnan wuxuu ku soo koray guri buuq badan oo kalgacal leh, qof walbana qayliyo oo aan cidina ciil hayn. Huda waxay ku kortay guri deggan, cod kor loo qaadana uu ka dhigan yahay in wax si daran u qaldan yihiin. Murankoodii ugu horreeyay ee dhab ah si xun buu ku dhammaadaa. Labadoodaba la soco albaab la isku dhuftay, raalli-gelin aan waxba sixin, iyo wada-hadal ku saabsan guryihii ay ka soo kala yimaadeen.
content.adv-raised-voice.cover.alt: Lammaane jikada iska soo horjeeda muran ka dib.
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.A.name: Adnan
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.A.sketch: Qalbi diirran, cod dheer; dhaqso ayuu u xanaaqaa, dhaqso ayuuna u illoobaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.B.name: Huda
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.B.sketch: Deggan oo feejigan; codku markuu kaco aad bay u aamustaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.safety.label: Dareen ammaan
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.safety.readin: Huda muranka dhexdiisa ammaan ma dareemayso.
Muranku waa wax la maareyn karo.
Labadooduba si ammaan ah ayay isku khilaafi karaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.understanding: Waxay fahmeen halka kan kale ka yimid.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.repair.label: Dib-u-heshiisiin
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.repair.readin: Si fiican oo degdeg ah ayay wax u hagaajiyaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.title: Muranka
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.image.a: Adnan oo codka kor u qaadaya, Hudana aamustay.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.passage: Furayaasha baabuurka ayay ka bilaabataa, dabadeed wax walba ayay isu beddeshaa. Codka Adnan wuu sii kacayaa. Saxan baa dhaca oo jaba. Huda gebi ahaanba way aamustaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.decisio: Adigu Adnan baad tahay. Maxaad samaynaysaa?
Hadalka dhexdiisa istaag. “Waan qaylinayaa. Waan ka xumahay. Aan is dejiyo.”
Adnan qaylada dhexdeeda ayuu is joojiyay, raalli-gelin buuna bixiyay.
Sii wad, weli ma dhammayn, run ahaantiina iyada uma xanaaqsana.
Xanaaq ku bax oo albaabka isku dhufo.
Adnan xanaaq ayuu ku baxay albaabkana wuu isku dhuftay.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.title: Intaas ka dib
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.image.alt: Huda oo keligeed sariirta geeskeeda fadhida muranka ka dib.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.passages.0: Huda way gariiraysaa. Iyadu, cod kor loo qaado weligiis wuxuu uga dhignaa in wax aad u xun dhaceen.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.passages.1: Codkii albaabka la isku dhuftay weli wuu dhegaha ugu dhacayaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.decision.p: Adigu Huda baad tahay. Maxaad samaynaysaa?
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.decision.c: Marka dambe Adnan u sheeg: “Markaad qayliso, waan baqaa, xataa haddii aadan sidaas ula jeedin.”
Huda waxay Adnan u sheegtay in qayladiisu cabsi geliso.
Waxba ha odhan. Maalmo taxaddar badan ku ag joog.
Huda maalmo ayay aamustay oo aad u taxaddartay.
Hooyadeed wac oo habeenka la joog.
Huda habeenka ayay hooyadeed la joogtay.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.title: Raalli-gelinta
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.image.al: Adnan oo ubax u sida, balse raalli-gelintiisu aanay gaadhin.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.passages: Adnan wuxuu u imanayaa inuu raalli-geliyo. Qoyskiisa, qofku raalli-gelin buu bixiya, hab buu siiyaa, arrintuna way dhammaataa.
Waxay joogtaa guriga hooyadeed. Waa inuu tago oo albaabka waalidkeed garaaco.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.decision: “Waan ka xumahay wixii hore, wax walba ma hagaagsan yihiin?” dabadeed hab sii.
Adnan si degdeg ah ayuu u raalli-geliyay, habna u fidiyay.
“Waan ka xumahay. Ma ii sheegi kartaa sida ay adiga kula ahayd?”
Adnan wuu raalli-geliyay, wuxuuna weydiiyay sida ay iyada ula ahayd.
U sharax in qayladu qoyskiisa caadi ka tahay; yaanay qalbiga u qaadan.
Adnan wuxuu u sharxay in qayladu qoyskiisa caadi ka tahay.
Aqbal si ay arrintu u dhammaato.
Huda raalli-gelinta way aqbashay si ay arrintu u dhammaato.
U sharax waxa codka kor loo qaado gurigeeda uga dhignaa.
Huda waxay u sharaxday waxa cod kor loo qaado gurigeeda uga dhignaa.
Huda waxay tidhi weli diyaar uma aha.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.title: Guryihii aynu ka nimi
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.image.alt: Adnan iyo Huda oo sawirradii carruurnimada wada eegaya.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.passages.0: Toddobaad ka dib, waxay ka wada hadlayaan guryihii ay ku koreen, midkii buuqa badnaa iyo kii degganaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.lessons.rv: Wadajir ku doorta. Haddii aad kala aragti duwanaataan, ka wada hadla oo haddana doorta.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.decision.c: Calaamad: midkiin ha yidhaahdo “hakad”, labaatan daqiiqo kala maqnaada, dabadeedna soo noqda.
Waxay ku heshiiyeen calaamad hakad iyo nasasho labaatan daqiiqo ah.
Cod kor loo qaado marnaba ma jiri doono, mawduuc kasta ha ahaadee.
Waxay ku heshiiyeen inaan codka marnaba kor loo qaadin.
Xeer gaar ah ma jiro, keliya dadaal dheeraad ah ayay samaynayaan.
Waxay ku heshiiyeen inay dadaal dheeraad ah sameeyaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.second.title: Murankii labaad
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.second.image.alt: Adnan oo is qabanaya intii muranku socday.
Bil ka dib, muran kale, walaashiis oo laba toddobaad la joogaysa awgeed. Adnan wuxuu dareemayaa inuu codkiisu kacayo.
Adigu Adnan baad tahay. Maxaad samaynaysaa?
“Hakad.” Jikada u gudub, shaah samee, labaatan daqiiqo ka dibna soo noqo.
Adnan hakad ayuu codsaday, dabadeed isagoo deggan ayuu soo noqday.
Dareen codkiisa, si ula kac ahna hoos ugu dhig.
Adnan wuu dareemay codkiisa, hoosna ayuu u dhigay.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.title: Dhinaca Huda
Huda oo si adag miiska dhiniciisa kale uga hadlaysa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.passag: Huda iyaduna wax bay ka beddeli kartaa: gurigeeda dadku maalmo ayay aamusi jireen halkii ay qaylin lahaayeen.
Mar kale ayuu qayliyay. Iyaduna saddex maalmood ayay aamusanayd.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.decisi: Adigu Huda baad tahay. Maxaad samaynaysaa?
Sheeg waxa aad u baahan tahay halkii aad aamusi lahayd.
Huda waxay sheegtay waxa ay u baahan tahay halkii ay aamusi lahayd.
Aamus, sida qoyskeedu wax uga qaban jireen.
Huda way aamustay, sidii qoyskeedu mar walba yeeli jireen.
Soo jeedi inay la-taliye wada arkaan.
Huda waxay soo jeedisay inay la-taliye wada arkaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.imag: Adnan iyo Huda oo dhoolla-caddayn ku hakad codsanaya.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.what: “Hakad” waxay noqotay eray qoyska u gaar ah. Weli way murmaan, balse cidina kama baqdo.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.patt: Hab wadajir ah oo muranka loo wajaho
Waxay abuureen calaamad ku habboon waayo-aragnimadii labadoodaba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.coul: Wax yar, inkastoo inay ka hor arooska ka hadlaan guryihii ay ku koreen ay caawin lahayd.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.take: Lammaane kastaa wuu murmaa. Kuwa sii jira waxay ku heshiiyaan sida loo murmo.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.epil: Qoyska Adnan ee qaylada badan ayaa iyaguna bilaabay inay yidhaahdaan “hakad”.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.guid: Midkeen “hakad” ayuu odhan karaa; labaatan daqiiqo ayaynu kala maqnaannaa dabadeedna soo noqonnaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.imag: Adnan oo Huda si feejigan u dhegaysanaya.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.what: Habeenkii uu weydiiyay “sidee bay adiga kula ahayd?” ayaa beddelay sida Adnan u murmo.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.patt: In falcelinta kan kale loo arko waayo-aragnimadiisa, weerar ma aha, ayaa wax walba beddeshay.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.take: Falcelin kasta oo xooggan waxaa ka dambeeya guri uu qof ku soo koray.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.guid: Marka midkeen si xooggan u falceliyo, waxaynu is weydiinnaa halka ay ka timid.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.title: Taxaddar joogto ah
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.image: Huda oo si taxaddar leh Adnan agtiisa ugu socota.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.whatH: Adnan hadda dhif ayuu u qayliyaa. Huda weli way is diyaarisaa mar kasta oo uu taahdo.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.patte: Qayladii way joogsatay; cabsida se marnaba lagama wada hadlin.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.could: Raalli-gelin weydiinaysa dareenkeeda, ee aan ku koobnayn “waan ka xumahay”.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.takea: Joojinta dhaqanku lama mid aha bogsiinta dhaawaca.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.guide: Markaynu is dhaawacno, si buuxda ayaynu uga wada hadalnaa ilaa dhaawacu bogsado.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.title: Mar kale ayay dhacdaa
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.image: Adnan iyo Huda oo fadhiga darafyo kala duwan ka aamusan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.whatH: Murankii qaylada lahaa iyo aamusnaantii dheeraa way is daba socdaan. Mid walba kan kale ayuu uga sii daraa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.patte: Qayladiisu aamusnaanteeda ayay kicisaa; aamusnaanteeduna xanaaqiisa ayay sii kordhisaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.could: Calaamad hakad ah, iyo inay labadooduba magacaabaan hab-dhaqankooda.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.takea: Codkiisa dheer iyo aamusnaanteedu waa laba dhinac oo isla hab-dhaqanka ah. Wadajir u beddela.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.guide: Habka murankeenna cod dheer ayaynu ku magacaabnaa, wadajirna uga shaqaynaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.title: Caawimo waydiisasho
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.image.a: Adnan iyo Huda oo la-taliye la jooga.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.whatHap: Waxay bilaabeen inay la-taliye Muslim ah wada arkaan. Waa go’aankii ugu fiicnaa sannadkoodii koowaad.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.pattern: Hab-dhaqankooda waxay u arkeen wax ay wax ka baran karaan, ceeb ma aha.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.couldHa: Waxba, caawimo waydiisashadu xoog bay ahayd.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.takeawa: Caawimo goor hore raadintu waxay muujinaysaa sida aad isu danaynaysaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.guide.r: Kibir nagama hor istaago inaan guurkeenna caawimo u raadino.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.title: Dusha laga daboolay
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.image.a: Adnan iyo Huda oo sawir ku dhoolla-caddaynaya, sawirkiina looxu dildillaacsan yahay.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.whatHap: Mar kasta raalli-gelin degdeg ah iyo hab. Wax walba waxay u muuqdaan hagaag ilaa tan xigta.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.pattern: Raalli-gelinta degdegga ahi waxay ka booday qaybtii ay isku fahmi lahaayeen.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.couldHa: In la weydiiyo “sidee bay adiga kula ahayd?”
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.takeawa: Raalli-gelin degdeg ahi muranka way joojisaa. Isfahamkuna hab-dhaqanka ayuu joojiyaa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.guide.r: Raalli-gelintayada waxa ku jira inaan is weydiinno sida uu kan kale dareemay.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.title: Isbarasho sii socota
Adnan iyo Huda oo weel wada dhaqaya.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.whatHa: Murannada qaar way ka fiican yihiin kuwa kale. Waxay baranayaan calaamadaha midba midka kale.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.patter: Guryo kala duwan waxay lahaayeen xeerar kala duwan; iyaguna xeerar cusub bay dejinayaan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.couldH: Calaamad ay ku heshiiyaan ayaa hawsha soo dedejin lahayd.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.takeaw: Mid walba xeerarkii qoyskiisa ayuu guurka la yimaadaa. Wadajir xeerarkiinna u sameysta.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.epilog: Huda mararka qaarkood weli way aamustaa; Adnan wuxuu bartay inuu dareemo.
Xeerarkeenna muranka annagaa samaysanna, waalidkeenna kama soo min-guurinno.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.imag: Adnan iyo Huda oo qolka fadhiga deggan wax ku akhrinaya.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.what: Cod kor loo qaado marnaba ma jiro. Waa deggan tahay. Mararka qaar Adnan wuxuu dareemaa inuusan guriga naftiisa ku ahaan karin.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.patt: Xeerku Huda wuu ilaaliyay, balse wuxuu Adnan ka dalbaday inuu qariyo wax dhab ah oo isaga ka mid ah.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.coul: Xeer labadoodaba u shaqeeya, sida calaamad hakad ah.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.take: Xeer fiican labada qof ayuu ilaaliyaa, mid keliya ma aha.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.guid: Xeerarka murankeenna labadeenna waa inay ku habboonaadaan.
